text: Done at 6ed61f9b (shared, JVM+JS 51/51 transform tests). VectorFieldNifti codec for (x,y,z,1,3) and (x,y,z,3) containers, value-exact via NiftiWriter (float64); DenseLattice builds reframe4s DenseMap[T,S] over Grid.forFrame(target) with CoordinateBoundaryPolicy.Reject default (no silent identity outside the field; absolute fields never treated as displacements). LpsDisplacementInterpretation.Ants/AfniQwarp (target p -> p + d_LPS, lattice qform-first per ITK NIfTI IO); FnirtFieldInterpretation (relative r+v / absolute v in FSL coords via source FslVolumeGeometry; lattice = field's own FSL geometry) with FnirtDetection (FOV test then least-squares volume-change test via Gale leastSquares; typed AmbiguousFnirtDefinition). Oracles: itk_field (SimpleITK 2.5.6 DisplacementFieldTransform on the vendored 5D warp, 12 interior points, 1e-5 mm, float32 field); fsl_dense_oracle all 8 handedness x relative/absolute cases against FSL 5.0.9 applywarp RAS ramps inside support (3e-5 mm) and detection correct in all 8. CAVEATS: AFNI 3dQwarp shares the LPS layout but has no native AFNI warp oracle yet; real 5D ANTs antsApplyTransforms oracle pending P4.03; FSL 6 pending P4.04.
